# Platform settings · Organization policy

## Organizations

<a id="OrganizationEnabled"></a>

### Organizations

Key `OrganizationEnabled` · Type bool · Default `true`

Where: Platform settings › Organization policy › Organizations

Users can create and join organizations that share a balance, members, budgets and API keys. When off, users no longer see organizations and the organization API refuses every request; site admins still manage the existing ones, which are kept as they are.

See also: [Organizations per user](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationMaxPerUser) · [Default member limit](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationDefaultMaxMembers) · [Personal balance transfer into organizations](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationQuotaTransferEnabled)

<a id="OrganizationQuotaTransferEnabled"></a>

### Personal balance transfer into organizations

Key `OrganizationQuotaTransferEnabled` · Type bool · Default `true`

Where: Platform settings › Organization policy › Organizations

An organization's owner or admins can move their own personal balance into the organization's shared balance. The transfer is one-way: nothing moves back to a personal account. When off, transfers are refused.

See also: [Organizations](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationEnabled) · [Balance of a deleted organization](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationDissolveQuotaRefund)

<a id="OrganizationMaxPerUser"></a>

### Organizations per user

Key `OrganizationMaxPerUser` · Type int · Range 0– · Default `3`

Where: Platform settings › Organization policy › Organizations

How many organizations one user can create. Organizations they only joined do not count, nor deleted ones. 0 means no limit.

Examples:

- `3` A user who created 3 organizations must delete one before creating a fourth; joining others is not limited.
- `1` Each user runs at most one organization of their own.
- `0` Users create as many organizations as they like.

See also: [Organizations](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationEnabled) · [Default member limit](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationDefaultMaxMembers)

<a id="OrganizationDefaultMaxMembers"></a>

### Default member limit

Key `OrganizationDefaultMaxMembers` · Type int · Range 0– · Default `10`

Where: Platform settings › Organization policy › Organizations

How many members an organization can have when a site admin has not set a limit for that organization. Changing it applies to every organization without a limit of its own, existing ones included. 0 means no limit.

Examples:

- `10` An organization with 10 members cannot add an 11th until a site admin raises its limit.
- `0` Organizations without a limit of their own take any number of members.

See also: [Organizations per user](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationMaxPerUser) · [Organizations](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationEnabled)

<a id="OrganizationDissolveQuotaRefund"></a>

### Balance of a deleted organization

Key `OrganizationDissolveQuotaRefund` · Type enum · Default `owner` · rarely changed

Where: Platform settings › Organization policy › Organizations

What happens to an organization's remaining shared balance when it is deleted, by its owner or a site admin. It has no field on the settings page and is only set through the option API (PUT /api/option/). Any value other than owner discards the balance.

Values:

- `owner` Return to the owner: The remaining shared balance goes to the owner's personal account, with a log entry.
- `discard` Discard: The remaining shared balance is cleared and returned to nobody.

See also: [Personal balance transfer into organizations](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationQuotaTransferEnabled) · [Organizations](./orgpolicy.md#OrganizationEnabled)
